project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (FER onboarding/admin) — React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Prisma + Postgres, server actions
build_system: npm; next build (Turbopack). Scripts in package.json: dev/build/start only. Prisma client via @prisma/client ^6.19.3.
test_framework: NONE — there is no test runner. Verification is tsc + build only.
test_command: npx tsc --noEmit   (zero errors) ; then npm run build (exit 0)
verification_instructions: Run ALL verification from the worktree root c:\Sir project\ontask\.worktrees\security-pin . Order: (1) npx prisma generate after any schema change (none expected). (2) npx tsc --noEmit must report zero errors. (3) npm run build must exit 0. For the data-migration script: set the key then run node scripts/encrypt-id-fields.cjs, then run it a SECOND time to confirm idempotency (0 encrypted).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated into node_modules via `npx prisma generate`; it is NOT checked in. No schema change is needed for this task (driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber are already String?), so no new migration should be created.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. AGENTS.md (both repo root and worktree) mandates: 'This is NOT the Next.js you know — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.' That docs folder IS present. Match stable Next 16 conventions already in neighboring files: 'use server' at top of server-action files, `await params`, `await searchParams`, `await cookies()`, `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`. SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY lives in .env; the migration script reads it from the process env with a .env fallback (same pattern as scripts/encrypt-ssns.cjs). Reuse the SAME key for the new ID fields — never generate a new one.
contribution_requirements: Keep edits minimal and style-matching. PIN is strictly ADDITIVE — never weaken existing role/ownership/site auth. No raw or ciphertext secret may ever reach a client component: only server-computed masked strings (maskLast4/maskSsn output). Masked last-4 and the reveal eye render ONLY inside the same per-field canView guard; a role that can't view a field sees '—', never last-4, and gets no eye. revealField decrypt is HARD -> DECRYPT_FAILED; display paths use safeDecrypt+mask so legacy/corrupt rows mask without crashing.
key_patterns: Crypto: src/lib/crypto.ts has encryptSecret/decryptSecret/isEncrypted/safeDecrypt, encSsn (trim/empty->null/encrypt), maskSsn (bullets + last4). Reveal: src/app/admin/pin/actions.ts revealSsn(pin, employeeId) applies a 3-part additive gate (per-field canView AND canFullView AND non-admin site restriction) with HARD decrypt->DECRYPT_FAILED. GatedResult server actions (src/lib/gatedResult.ts) with a shared checkPin(form) helper that maps requirePin's NO_PIN to {pinRequired:true}. Client secret UI: SsnField.tsx (display + eye) and grid/SsnEditCell.tsx (edit + eye) receive ONLY the masked value + employeeId. PinDialog.tsx is the shared modal (open/onConfirm/onCancel/title/description, pinRequired -> setup CTA to /admin/profile#pin). rbac.ts: getAccessMap(role) -> AccessMap; canView/canEdit/canApprove; column keys include driverLicense, safetyExpiry, twicExpiry, ssn, library (no separate safetyCouncil/twic ID keys). Dark theme already uses slate-900/60 cards, white/10 borders, cyan-400 accents, gradient buttons.

fixes_binding.FIX1_accuracy: Do NOT claim SAFETY gains ID visibility. The employee-detail Details <dl> is inside {canFullView && (...)} (page.tsx ~line 558). canFullView = canLib || assignedToMe || granted; canLib = canView(access,'library') || hasFullDocumentAccess. By rbac defaults only HR has library:VIEW; SAFETY/ACCOUNT_MANAGER/PROJECT_MANAGER/TRACKS/EMPLOYEE default library:HIDDEN and are redirected before Details. Non-admin role that both clears canFullView and holds a field-view key by default = HR only (plus per-row assigned PL/PM or one-off grant). Per-field guard tightening must not expose a field to any role that cannot already see it.
fixes_binding.FIX2_select: In revealField, read the column via a `satisfies Prisma.EmployeeSelect` select and a direct e[column] read — do NOT use `select: { [column]: true } as const` (won't type-check). In invoices CSV export, import maskLast4 OR reuse maskSsn (it delegates to maskLast4) for the driverLicense case — pick one, make it compile; never emit DL ciphertext.
fixes_binding.FIX3_write_dispatch: SecretEditCell save/clear dispatches by field via explicit lookup: const WRITE_ACTION: Partial<Record<SecretFieldKey,(fd:FormData)=>Promise<GatedResult>>> = { ssn: setEmployeeSsn, driversLicense: setEmployeeDriversLicense }; never route a DL save through the SSN column.
fixes_binding.FIX4_eye_and_mount: SecretField/SecretEditCell render the eye ONLY when canReveal is true (no dead-end FORBIDDEN eye). In the grid, table + card instances are both MOUNTED (CSS-hidden); per-instance reveal state is fine ONLY because SecretField has no mount-time side effect (no autofocus/auto-open) — keep it that way (document in a comment).
fixes_binding.FIX5_encField_idempotent: encField must start with `if (typeof value === 'string' && isEncrypted(value)) return value;` so a missed prefill-decrypt cannot double-encrypt.

directory_structure: src/lib = crypto, rbac, auth, pinGate, gatedResult, employeeImport, prisma client, email, storage. src/app/admin = admin shell (layout.tsx) + grid/ (data grid page + per-cell client components SsnEditCell/EditableCell/SiteCell/RateCell/etc.) + employee/[id]/ (detail/library page) + invoices/ + timesheets/ + users/ + profile/ + pin/actions.ts (reveal + unlock) + PinDialog.tsx/SsnField.tsx/PinConfirmButton.tsx (shared client). src/app/onboard/[token] = public onboarding form (page.tsx prefill + actions.ts submit/draft + OnboardingForm.tsx). src/app/login. scripts/ = CommonJS maintenance scripts (encrypt-ssns.cjs is the template for the new encrypt-id-fields.cjs). prisma/schema.prisma: Employee.ssn/driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber all String?; safetyCouncilExpiry/twicExpiry DateTime?.
schema_note: driversLicenseNumber, safetyCouncilId, twicNumber are already String? on Employee — making them encrypted-at-rest is NO schema shape change. Do NOT add a Prisma migration. The expiry DATE fields stay plaintext.
import_note: src/lib/employeeImport.ts in THIS worktree has ONLY a createMany write path (importRows) — there is NO update branch and NO ciphertext-equality duplicate check. Encrypt the three IDs at the single existing write point with encField. If an update branch is later added it must encrypt too.
